payload.text: hv, 19 Oct 2026, directly to utilz-cc, on the 82 TMPDIR entries that other tests leave on Linux (found in dc's slot 177): "Nix them, please." It goes in 2.14.1, as utilz-cc's issue, design first. The cut already waits for 0072, and the gate reruns at the head with 0072 in, so this fix lands after the early gate at 910af45 (178) and before that rerun. While 178 runs, cc reads, files and designs, and builds only in its own worktree. Its booked runs queue behind 178 and 179, and nothing commits in the primary until 178's report.
